facts.fact: Nick 相貌平凡得令人失望，Isabel 记不住他的脸。
facts.anchor: He was disappointingly and peculiarly plain.

facts.fact: 看到他时她想起 Alexander 家族纹章传说里被杀死的狼回来复仇。
facts.anchor: here is the wolf, come for his revenge.

facts.fact: Nick 在走廊里向她自我介绍，称是丈夫的同事。
Nick 说 Alexander 是他最出色的学生（old teacher）。
Alexander 恰在此时出现，神情像忘了 Isabel 的存在。
facts.anchor: Alexander chose that moment to round the corner and join us.

facts.fact: 回房后她突然决定独自出门散步。
facts.anchor: I decided, on a sudden whim, that I was going for a walk.

facts.fact: 坐在湖边她怀疑自己也被这片土地蛊惑。
老渔夫 Stewart 临别时隐晦地警告她小心。
facts.anchor: You be careful up there, will ye?
